channel.title: SINless — Renraku Arcology Arc
channel.description: A filtered fan playlist of the SINless Shadowrun actual-play episodes covering the Renraku Arcology storyline. Audio and episode metadata remain hosted by and credited to the original publisher, Critical Hits.
channel.author: Critical Hits
channel.itunes:author: Critical Hits
channel.itunes:summary: Hoi chummers! SINless is a Shadowrun actual play podcast that follows a group of nobodies as they navigate life in the shadows of the 6th World. Thrown together by chance they'll need to keep each other alive as they gain notoriety in all the wrong places and make a name for themselves with all the wrong people.
